lede: Tulsa carries the stronger underlying team rating — -1.9 against -5.8, a 3.9-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Tulsa +5.6 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Army winning 65% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is pass defense, where Tulsa leads Army by 107 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 85% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
